title: Halcyon Drift Rising Anew
author: Ines Eriksen
blurb: Cyrus Sandoval, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
